intro.title: Building scalable enterprise platforms.
intro.subtitle: I'm Golden Ogbeka, a Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience designing and shipping secure, scalable products across fintech, banking, edtech, logistics, and commerce. I've built enterprise corporate banking platforms for Abbey Bank, FCMB Group, and Sterling Bank — powering bulk payments, multi-currency accounts, treasury operations, and maker-checker approvals trusted across Nigeria and the UK. As a builder and former CTO, I deliver the full stack: from React and React Native frontends to Node.js backends, cloud infrastructure, and the reusable component systems that make teams faster. Whether you need a mission-critical financial platform, a frictionless user experience, or a product taken from idea to scale, I turn complex requirements into reliable, beautiful, production-grade software.
